## Documentation

A chat event from the recent actions log (also known as admin log).

See `action` to know which kind of event this is and the relative attributes to get the event content.

### Parameters

- **`id`** (`int`)
  Chat event identifier.

- **`date`** (`datetime`)
  Date of the event.

- **`action`** ([`ChatEventAction`](../../enums/ChatEventAction.md))
  Event action.

- **`user`** ([`User`](User.md))
  User that triggered the event.

old_description, new_description (`str`, *optional*):
  Previous and new chat description.
  For `DESCRIPTION_CHANGED` action only.

old_history_ttl, new_history_ttl (`int`, *optional*):
  Previous and new chat history TTL.
  For `HISTORY_TTL_CHANGED` action only.

old_linked_chat, new_linked_chat ([`Chat`](Chat.md), *optional*):
  Previous and new linked chat.
  For `LINKED_CHAT_CHANGED` action only.

old_photo, new_photo ([`Photo`](../messages_and_media/Photo.md), *optional*):
  Previous and new chat photo.
  For `PHOTO_CHANGED` action only.

old_title, new_title (`str`, *optional*):
  Previous and new chat title.
  For `TITLE_CHANGED` action only.

old_username, new_username (`str`, *optional*):
  Previous and new chat username.
  For `USERNAME_CHANGED` action only.

old_chat_permissions, new_chat_permissions ([`ChatPermissions`](ChatPermissions.md), *optional*):
  Previous and new default chat permissions.
  For `CHAT_PERMISSIONS_CHANGED` action only.

- **`deleted_message`** ([`Message`](../messages_and_media/Message.md), *optional*)
  Deleted message.
  For `MESSAGE_DELETED` action only.

old_message, new_message ([`Message`](../messages_and_media/Message.md), *optional*):
  Previous and new message before it has been edited.
  For `MESSAGE_EDITED` action only.

- **`invited_member`** ([`ChatMember`](ChatMember.md), *optional*)
  New invited chat member.
  For `MEMBER_INVITED` action only.

old_administrator_privileges, new_administrator_privileges ([`ChatMember`](ChatMember.md), *optional*):
  Previous and new administrator privileges.
  For `ADMINISTRATOR_PRIVILEGES_CHANGED` action only.

old_member_permissions, new_member_permissions ([`ChatMember`](ChatMember.md), *optional*):
  Previous and new member permissions.
  For `MEMBER_PERMISSIONS_CHANGED` action only.

- **`stopped_poll`** ([`Message`](../messages_and_media/Message.md), *optional*)
  Message containing the stopped poll.
  For `POLL_STOPPED` action only.

- **`invites_enabled`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  If chat invites were enabled (True) or disabled (False).
  For `INVITES_ENABLED` action only.

- **`history_hidden`** (`bool`, *optional*)
  If chat history has been hidden (True) or unhidden (False).

  If message signatures were enabled (True) or disabled (False).
  For `SIGNATURES_ENABLED` action only.

old_slow_mode, new_slow_mode (`int`, *optional*):
  Previous and new slow mode value in seconds.
  For `SLOW_MODE_CHANGED` action only.

- **`unpinned_message`** ([`Message`](../messages_and_media/Message.md), *optional*)
